lots.guide_summary: Only one surviving close entry: a $50 Gowans hammer (Dec 2025) for a box of loose Transformers, so the range is $50 to $50, all SOLD, no UNSOLD or ASKING. Category guides at Gowans: mixed toy tubs $10 to $25, single loose G1 figures about $20, single figures with books and accessories $30 to $65. All AUD hammer, premium 19.8% extra, no conversion.
lots.working: Keep: lowest surviving close SOLD = $50 (Gowans 380768, Dec 2025, within 24 months). 50 / 1.198 = 41.74, round down to $40. Flip: likely resale from the SOLD evidence about $50 for the tub as a lot; selling via eBay or similar, 13% fees ($6.50) and about $20 outbound postage for a bulky tub = $23.50 net. 23.50 / 2.396 = 9.81, round down to $5. Not a real flip unless the tub holds complete G2 Constructicons or other better pieces that can be parted out, which no SOLD evidence here supports. Pickup from 37 Main Road Moonah, inbound freight $0.
lots.confidence_reason: One photo of a full tub (partial view, contents underneath unseen), no maker marks read, and only one close SOLD comparable (seen via Gowans API plus its photo). Other entries are category guides.
lots.dropped_entries: Dropped '3 TRANSFORMERS INCL TRI-ANG & OLYMPUS' (id 423463, $20) and '2 TRANSFORMERS' (id 430168, $40): photos show electrical transformers (model-railway controllers, a voltage regulator), not toys. Researcher had them as Transformers figures; that was wrong. Also ignored 'TUB OF ELECTRICAL TRANSFORMERS' (433156) for the same reason. Researcher's $40/$60/$65 combined entry kept but relabelled as a category guide at its lowest price ($30 entry now covers it). WebSearch was unavailable (session cap reached), so no external sold, unsold or asking evidence was checked.
lots.key_photo_findings: Enlarged crops show a yellow and purple splash-deco construction vehicle consistent with Generation 2 (1993) Constructicons, a silver/black trailer with an 'OPTIMUS PRIME' sticker and 'LOCK' label (an Optimus trailer from a G2 or later release), a separate black and red 'OPTIMUS PRIME' cab, Beast-era figures with blue-grey crab claws, maroon G1-style parts. Researcher's 'Armada/Energon-era' reading of the trailer is not confirmed; it looks earlier (G2 era). No Hasbro/Takara marks visible.
lots.condition: Loose, play-worn, stickers partly worn; completeness unknown and almost certainly incomplete (missing weapons and accessories likely).
